start.title: A Boy in the Tabernacle
start.text:
The lamps must be tended before night.
Eli rests in the next chamber.

choices.feedback: Service is your gift to give.
The flame steadies in your hand.
Quiet duty is sacred too.

sneak_consequence.title: Return to Your Post
sneak_consequence.text:
The sanctuary needs a faithful hand.
Go back and tend the lamp.

choices.feedback: You bow your head and serve.

demand_consequence.title: Greatness in Smallness
demand_consequence.text:
Even small duties shape a prophet.
Do what is set before you.

choices.feedback: Light glows on your face.

night_falls.title: A Voice in the Dark
night_falls.text:
You lie down. Then a voice: "Samuel."
It must be Eli calling you.

choices.text: Run to Eli to answer him
choices.feedback: You hurry through the dim hall.
A call answered is a heart awake.
Honor the elder with your steps.

ignore_consequence.title: Do Not Hide
ignore_consequence.text:
A voice that calls deserves an answer.
Rise and go to Eli.

choices.text: Run to Eli to answer him
choices.feedback: You step into the corridor.

shout_consequence.title: Honor the Elder
shout_consequence.text:
Do not shout in the holy house.
Go to him on quiet feet.

choices.text: Run to Eli to answer him
choices.feedback: You walk softly to his door.

second_call.title: Eli Did Not Call
second_call.text:
"I did not call you, my son."
You return. The voice comes again.

choices.text: Doubt your own ears and sleep
choices.feedback: A whisper this clear is real.

choices.text: Curse the voice as a trick
choices.feedback: Do not slander what you don't know.
Faithful steps in the dark.

doubt_consequence.title: Trust What You Heard
doubt_consequence.text:
The voice was not a dream.
Go to Eli and tell him again.

choices.feedback: You rise once more.

curse_consequence.title: Guard Your Tongue
curse_consequence.text:
You do not yet know the speaker.
Go seek Eli's wisdom.

choices.feedback: You bow your head and go.

third_call.title: Eli Understands
third_call.text:
Eli's old eyes soften with knowing.
"It is the Lord who calls you."

choices.feedback: Do not flee the voice of God.

choices.text: Go back and wait to listen
choices.feedback: Eli's hand rests on your shoulder.
Holy ground asks for silence.

refuse_consequence.title: Do Not Run
refuse_consequence.text:
The Lord chose this quiet hour.
Go back and listen.

choices.text: Go back and wait to listen
choices.feedback: You return to the dark room.

boast_consequence.title: A Listening Heart
boast_consequence.text:
Pride dulls the ear of the soul.
Go and listen in silence.

choices.text: Go back and wait to listen
choices.feedback: You bow your head low.

respond_god.title: The Voice Returns
respond_god.text:
"Samuel, Samuel."
Your heart trembles in the stillness.

choices.feedback: Answer Him as Eli taught.
Trust the voice that calls you.
The room fills with quiet light.

hide_consequence.title: Lift Your Head
hide_consequence.text:
He calls you by your name.
Answer Him with open heart.

choices.feedback: Your voice steadies as you speak.

sign_consequence.title: Faith Before Sight
sign_consequence.text:
His call is the sign itself.
Speak the words Eli gave you.

choices.feedback: You whisper into the dark.

prophet_calling.title: A Prophet to Israel
prophet_calling.text:
Dawn finds you a chosen voice.
All Israel will know the Lord speaks.
